itens.trecho: Português Quando os desastres apelam ao americanismo. Neste filme, dirigido por Roland Emmerich, novamente apostado em destruir a Terra, o nosso planeta é ameaçada por naves alienígenas gigantes sobre as principais cidades do planeta. Os primeiros ataques confirmam as piores expectativas: são hostis.

Disaster or alien movie (possibly even action movie) - it just doesn't get better than Independence Day! This 1996 sci-fi action blockbuster is one of the greatest of all time! When you watch the mega-blockbusters of the 1990s and compare them to each other, it is easy to forget how groundbreaking they really were.

If you like your sci-fi full of gung-ho machismo then this one ought to cut the mustard. On the face of it, it is quite an engaging story of mankind uniting in the face of overwhelming odds - a sort of blitz spirit.
